name: planning-commits
description: Triages an already-dirty Git working tree: breaks down every uncommitted change hunk by hunk, separates deliberate edits from tool-written churn, possibly accidental reversions, misplaced scope, and sensitive content, asks the user about the ambiguous cases, and proposes an ordered set of commits plus a list of hunks to hold back. Use when the user invokes `/pc` or `$pc`, asks what they should commit, wants their uncommitted changes broken down, or wants commits proposed for a dirty working tree or pile of accumulated local modifications. To plan commit boundaries for a change before or while implementing it, use `incremental-commits` instead.
